messages.subject: Error when fitting beta model
parts:
Hi INLA users,

I ran into an error message when fitting a Beta regression with INLA and the meaning of the message is unclear. Here it is:

*** ERROR *** INLA.Data1: Beta data[0] (y) = (0) or weight (1)is void

In this model, I only included the dependent variable and an intercept : y ~ 1. I assume the problem to come from the distribution of my dependent variable which is a percentage with a lot of zeros and 100s and a few intermediate values.


I have tried to rescale it but of course, it does not change the shape of the distribution so the weights stay the same and the same error message arises. Because I do not understand the error, I can’t tell what I should do to fix it. Can anyone give me some insights on this?

Thank you,
Camille
